sections.title: General Info
sections.description: Bluff your way to an empty hand. Call BS on suspicious claims.

sections.title: Game Rules
body: On your turn, play 1–4 cards face-down and announce a rank (for example, 3 tens).
Other players have a few seconds to Call BS.
If you were honest, the challenger takes the pile. If you bluffed, you take the pile.
If nobody calls, the pile stays and play continues.
First player to empty their hand wins.

sections.title: Strategy Tips
body: Bluff when others are low on cards.
Save matching ranks for clean plays when challenged.
Watch who empties first — Call BS when it matters.
